|errata_history=This is version PC-E3 of [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)|Kessel Surveillance System]]. The first printing is lost, so it has no page. Other versions: [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4), [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5, the current text). No published image prints this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-00-Kessel_Surveillance_System-PC-E3-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026; renamed from …-PC-E2-cardmaker.png on 11 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (first printing; no copy survives, so no page): the first Virtual Block 7.3 printing (official text as of 3 June 2011). No copy of it survives: the only surviving sheet was re-made on 25 July 2011 and already prints the PC-E1 errata<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 3, slip 10 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>. The errata post of 14 July 2011 shows that the first text was different; the PC website card list (PC-E3) later printed a pre-errata wording, which may be the first text, but the sheet's own words are not known.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 14 July 2011, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p636351">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 14 July 2011: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p636351 p636351] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may ▼ Spice Mine Administrator here.” '''What changed:''' “if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck” became “if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck”; “to satisfy” became “to make that Force satisfy”; the spellings are “Opponent's”, “Once” and “owner's”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]]): re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (still headed “official text as of 3 June 2011”; copy re-made 25 July 2011; slip marked E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 3, slip 10 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may ▼ Spice Mine Administrator here.” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E1 forum text. The forum post and the sheet are two publications, so two versions (Bill, 11 November 2026). A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1273_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponents Force drains are -1 here. Oncer per turn, if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owners Lost Pile to satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may deploy Spice Mine Administrator here.” '''What changed:''' the PC-E1 errata is gone: the list prints a pre-errata wording (“if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck … to satisfy”), with “Opponents”, “Oncer” and “owners”. A repeat of an earlier text after a different one was published is a version of its own (wiki versions ruling, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 4)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game may ▼ Moruth Doole here.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' the PC-E1 wording is back, with “Moruth Doole” for “Spice Mine Administrator” and no comma after “Once per game”.
* '''PC-E5''' ([[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 5)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Dark Side, p. 21)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=21, page 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=21 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game may ▼ Moruth Doole here.” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E4 text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
